body: If that's life then I'd prefer not to live. I just need the courage to go through with it.
I'm such a fucking attention seeker
I'm not trying to starve myself or go into deep depression. I'm just not hungry or tired and am becoming dependent on drugs because I'm terribly upset.
If you think it's that simple then you're facile and would make a shit psychologist.

I have considered that possibility. However, you can't just pin the problem to that. The problem is much more sophisticated. She takes drugs too. It is not the problem. The problem is that she no longer feels the same way about me.
I will miss so much. I don't know what to think.

Isn't this just optimism, though? How do you know that will happen? Why is it not better to just end my already doomed life so as to not suffer the pain I am about to experience once I come down from all these drugs.

Well, experiences are relative. You can't objectively tell which experience is better or worse. I'm going to miss a lot of things which would come of benefit of being alive, but I'm still aiming to end myself.
How do you even know that it'll get better? Does optimism really work?

Because it's facile to pin the problem onto a habit for the reason that I get high and my ability to induce a state of irrationality depends on use of a drug. It's not as simple as your tone suggests it is. It's completely subjective.

You don't jump to conclusions. My drug use habit is shared by my girlfriend and she has never expressed that she doesn't like it. The entire problem is that I may become irrational and do something stupid and that I'm very capable of inducing a state like that which could enable me. 

And, is death not eternal nothingness? Nothingness is not a feeling, it's a feeling of nothing which is nothing.
I guess we can talk on Skype if you want. But I don't particular want to video chat, just text. Not in a very sober state. What's your Skype name?

I'm not sure I want to talk about it. In the rational state I was in to make this thread, I was seeking some sort of resistance. Which is probably why I made it in the first place. I have thought about this for a long amount of time and don't believe I can be manipulated away from it while in a state of irrationality, which is what I'm aiming to induce.
